avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces ethosuximide plasma concentrations and seizure control efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, monitor seizure activity closely and may require ethosuximide dose adjustment

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May lower seizure threshold and reduce anticonvulsant efficacy of ethosuximide
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue ginkgo biloba or monitor seizure control; consider alternative supplements

caution_supplements.name: Valerian root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive CNS depression with ethosuximide; may increase drowsiness and dizziness
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; counsel patient on additive CNS effects and avoid driving if drowsiness occurs

caution_supplements.name: Kava
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate CNS depression and increase risk of hepatotoxicity with chronic ethosuximide use
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive sedation; limit use and counsel on hepatic monitoring

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression may increase drowsiness, dizziness, and impair coordination; may lower seizure threshold
caution_foods.action: Advise patient to minimize or avoid alcohol consumption; monitor for increased CNS effects

monitoring_notes: Monitor serum ethosuximide concentrations (therapeutic range: 40-100 mcg/mL) and seizure control, especially when initiating or discontinuing interacting supplements. Assess for CNS side effects (drowsiness, dizziness, ataxia) and counsel on medication adherence for seizure prevention.
